_doc: FHFA House Price Index release dates, transcribed from https://www.fhfa.gov/data/hpi#ReleaseDates (Date / Release Type / Last Included Data; 2026 and 2027 listed). The page states dates only; the TIME is stated by FHFA in its HPI report PDFs ('Public FHFA HPI releases occur at 9AM ET'), so date and time are both agency-stated (precision exact). Period label = the last included MONTH (quarterly releases also carry the monthly tables).
